name: Crânio de Lobo Guará - Porção Ventral
description:
Modelo 3D de crânio de lobo-guará (*Chrysocyon brachyurus*), integrante da Coleção Didática do Laboratório de Anatomia Comparada de Vertebrados (LACV), Universidade de Brasília (UnB). O modelo apresenta a identificação de alguns elementos ósseos, permitindo a observação de características morfológicas típicas da família Canidae, como focinho alongado e dentição adaptada a uma dieta onívora.

O lobo-guará é o maior canídeo da América do Sul e uma espécie emblemática do Cerrado, onde exerce papel ecológico relevante na dispersão de sementes e no equilíbrio trófico.

Autoria: Maria Eduarda Rodrigues da Silva (UnB/LACV).
Sketchfab: @madurdg.
Instagram: maduuurs.

name: Yoshi's Wolly World Diorama 🦕🦖🧶
description:
**"Yoshi's Woolly World Diorama"** 

Este diorama es una recreación detallada y encantadora inspirada en el su respectivo videojuego de Nintendo, siendo uno de mis videojuegos favoritos. 

En el modelo, presento a varios Yoshi en un entorno vibrante y colorido, con texturas que evocan un estilo artesanal, como si todo estuviera hecho de lana y materiales suaves. Este es un modelo 3D que he realizado completamente en Blender, utilizando materiales procedurales. Posteriormente, llevé a cabo el proceso de bake para optimizarlo y poder subirlo a Sketchfab. Es un trabajo hecho con mucho mimo y cariño, que espero transmita la emoción que sentí al crearlo.

Si quieres disfrutar de este diorama con mayor resolución y detalle, puedes encontrarlo en mi ArtStation y en las imágenes que he compartido. ¡Perfecto para los amantes de Yoshi, el arte retro y lo creativo!

name: Allosaurus King of the Jurassic
description: Allosaurus was a large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period, approximately 155 to 145 million years ago. Known for its role as one of the dominant predators of its time, Allosaurus was a formidable hunter, measuring up to 12 meters (39 feet) in length and weighing around 2.5 metric tons. Its robust build featured a massive skull with dozens of sharp, serrated teeth designed for slicing through flesh. The dinosaur’s strong, muscular legs and a long tail provided balance and agility, while its relatively short but powerful arms ended in three-fingered hands equipped with large claws, ideal for grasping and holding onto prey. Allosaurus had a keen sense of sight and smell, aiding in its predatory lifestyle. Fossil evidence suggests it was a versatile carnivore, preying on a variety of herbivorous dinosaurs, and possibly engaging in pack hunting to take down larger prey.

name: Cecropia moth
description:
Hyalophora cecropia, the cecropia moth, is North America's largest native moth. It is a member of the family Saturniidae, or giant silk moths. Females have been documented with a wingspan of five to seven inches (13 to 18 cm) or more. These moths can be found predominantly across the east of North America, with occurrences as far west as Washington and north into the majority of Canadian provinces. Cecropia moth larvae are most commonly found on maple trees, but they have also been found on cherry and birch trees among many others. The species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.

Learn more at: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyalophora_cecropia

Thanks to: https://sketchfab.com/E.A.Cornell for the original model: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/giant-peacock-moth-a4192a5a1c7746b6bf2695b043ada92f

name: Giant water bug
description:
Giant Florida Water Bug, *Lethocerus* sp.

Photogrammetry scan by the Florida Museum Digital Imaging division. https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/digital-lab/photogrammetry/

The heteropteran family Belostomatidae contains the giant water bugs. These large, predatory, aquatic insects have the largest body size among the Heteroptera. Adults of some South American species reach 4 inches in length. Individuals occur in ponds and ditches where they suspend below the surface, respiring through two abdominal appendages which act as siphons.  Individuals are capable of inflicting a painful bite with their strong beak, and may also pinch with their front legs. Individuals prey on aquatic insects, small fish, frogs, tadpoles, small birds, and other organisms they are able to capture. Powerful enzymes are injected into prey to kill them. Adults of Lethocerus are considered a delicacy in Asia, and are eaten both fresh and cooked.  - UF IFAS https://entnemdept.ufl.edu/creatures/misc/bugs/giant_water_bugs.htm

name: Dromaeosaur Figura Model
description:
This model is of a generic large Dromaeosaur, mainly based off *Utahraptor*. It was created for use in the Figura Minecraft mod as a custom player model. There are animations for virutally every player action in the game. 
In-game, coding contols tail side-to-side movement, which is why there's little of that in the model's animations themselves. Coding also takes care of blending animations together, so some are short and choppy with no transitions between them and the idle pose. Also, because of how Minecraft animations are programmed, the head and neck in the sneaking animations had to be offset in order to look normal in-game.
Here, the netherite armor is featured. There are variations of every armor, including turtle armor, in this model as well. Each looks slightly different and the stronger the armor, the cooler the design.

name: Amethystine Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

Amethystine Blight Drones are very quick and elusive, skittering about their hives gathering lichen and other cave plants. As herbivores, Amethystine drones and their Queen are largely docile, and will normally only attack when threatened or desperate.

**Other Things to Note:**  *These drones, while they normally survive on plants, have been recorded to store and eat gems and other precious minerals.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Amethystine Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/amethystine-blight-queen-1a9caad333b049c3a94c7648001d2b57)

name: Santa Reindeer
description:
Santa’s reindeer are not ordinary *Rangifer tarandus*—they are a distinct, magical species recognized as *Rangifer volans mirabilis* (“marvelous flying reindeer”). Unlike their terrestrial cousins, these creatures possess specialized adaptations for aerial travel. Their hooves are broad and luminescent, generating lift when striking snow or clouds. A dense, iridescent coat insulates them against the freezing stratosphere, while their cardiovascular system is uniquely tuned for supersonic endurance. Most striking is their nasal bioluminescence, famously exemplified by Rudolph, which aids navigation through storms. Social by nature, *Rangifer volans mirabilis* thrive in cooperative herds, their synchronized flight patterns allowing Santa’s sleigh to glide effortlessly across the globe. In folklore and science alike, they embody resilience, teamwork, and the enduring magic of winter.

name: Caraxes – The Blood Wyrm
description:
Caraxes, famously known as The Blood Wyrm, is one of the most iconic dragons from House of the Dragon. Renowned for his long serpentine neck, lean yet muscular body, crimson-black scales, and massive bat-like wings, Caraxes possesses a unique silhouette that sets him apart from every other dragon in Westeros.

This highly detailed 3D replica captures Caraxes in a dramatic perched pose atop a ruined medieval tower, with his wings fully spread and tail wrapped around the ancient stone structure. name: Biomech Zombie War Whale
description:
A massive, hyper-detailed 3D model of a biomechanical undead whale — a terrifying fusion of military machinery, rotting organic tissue, and experimental biotech.
The creature keeps the iconic whale silhouette (giant head, long body, wide fluke) but is completely transformed into a sci-fi horror weapon.

The front half is almost fully mechanized: armored metal plating, bolted panels, vent slits, pipes, sensors, cylindrical side modules, and a submarine-like viewing hatch. Behind the head, the plating transitions into pale, diseased flesh stitched together with exposed muscle fibers, tendons, and infected green patterns.

The spine is fully exposed, lined with black biomech growths resembling mechanical fins, servos, or fungal armor. Antennas, metal probes, and sensor rods protrude from the back, enhancing the creature’s militarized experimental weapon look.

name: Ogcocephalus vespertilio - MNCN38D
description:
**Description**: As an adaptation to its benthic lifestyle, its body has evolved to be broad and depressed, while its pectoral and pelvic fins have been modified into leg-like appendages. It is distributed throughout the tropical waters of the Western Atlantic, ranging from the Antilles to Brazil. Native tribes at the mouth of the Amazon River are known to use this species for the treatment of asthma. Historical specimen, captured in the Caribbean Sea in 1886.

**Specimen**: *Ogcocephalus vespertilio* (Linnaeus, 1758).

**Inventory number**: MNCN-38D

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Ictiología. Curator: Javier Díaz (javier.diaz@mncn.csic.es).

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/ictiologia).

Scanned with an Artec Spider in 2026 by Leticia Herrera and Carlos A. Palancar.

name: World Earth Day - Mexican Salamanders
description:
Ah, *now* it's World Earth Day. Very well then!
There are about 30 different species of salamander within genus *Ambystoma* - some of the rarest living in the highlands of Mexico.
Several of these are unusual in that unlike other salamanders; who transition to a terrestrial life on land, these salamanders never do - retaining functioning gills and body fins for their entire lives.
With the continued development of many parts of Mexico, many of such species are now close to extinction.

name: Spinosaurus
description: Spinosaurus was a colossal theropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period, approximately 112 to 93 million years ago. It is one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs known, reaching lengths of up to 50 feet and weighing as much as 20 tons. Spinosaurus is renowned for its distinctive sail-like structure, formed by elongated neural spines on its back, which could have been used for display, thermoregulation, or storage of fat. Another unique feature of Spinosaurus was its crocodile-like skull, equipped with conical teeth well-suited for catching fish, indicating a semi-aquatic lifestyle. Its elongated, muscular forelimbs, equipped with large claws, suggest it was adept at catching and handling prey. Fossils of Spinosaurus have been found in North Africa, particularly in Egypt and Morocco, painting a picture of a versatile and formidable predator that thrived in both terrestrial and aquatic environments.

name: Zhu Bao
description:
This charming polymer clay miniature celebrates the pig of the Chinese zodiac, blending playful stylization with symbolic detail. Rounded features, a friendly snout, and a sturdy stance evoke prosperity, abundance, and good fortune—values deeply tied to Lunar New Year traditions. The warm, smooth surface finish gives it a timeless, collectible feel, reminiscent of handcrafted festival figurines.

According to legend, the Zhu Bao is a celestial piglet born under a red lantern’s glow. On New Year’s Eve, it roams the streets unseen, scattering golden grains for those destined to prosper. To encounter it is said to bring twelve years of peace and plenty.

Meticulously 3D scanned for accuracy and preserved texture, this model is fully game-ready for VR, AR, or real-time rendering. Perfect for use as a cultural prop, seasonal collectible, or environmental detail in virtual worlds.

Stórmerkilegur gripur- leikfang fannst í skálanum frá 10. öld í Firði á Seyðisfirði, útskorið dýr úr gjóskubergi. Við höllumst að því að þetta sé svín, villisvín eða björn og sumir segja hundur. Dýrið er um 5 cm að lengd og 2,7 cm að hæð. Uppgröfturinn er á vegum Antikva ehf. undir stjórn Ragnheiðar Traustadóttur.

A remarkable artefact-A toy was found in the viking age longhouse in Fjörður in Seyðisfjörður in East Iceland, a carved animal made from Palagonite tuff. We lean towards it being a pig, boar or bear and some people say dog. The animal is about 5 cm in length and 2.7 cm in height. The excavation is overseen by Antikva ehf. under the direction of Ragnheiður Traustadóttir.

At first glance, Anatoly looks like any ordinary janitor mouse — small, quiet, fond of cleaning up crumbs and sweeping dark corners. But behind his unassuming whiskers lies a secret that’s turning heads (and breaking scales): Anatoly lifts.  

Discovered by accident in a rural barn outside Minsk, Anatoly shocked locals when he dragged an entire wrench set across the floor—twice his weight and then some. Since then, he’s been spotted bench-pressing nails, curling bottle caps, and deadlifting mousetraps with the calm focus of a seasoned strongman.  

No one knows how he does it. Scientists suggest a bizarre mutation. Others whisper about enchanted cheese. But to witnesses, it’s pure awe. “He’s got the strength of a dozen mice,” one onlooker said, “and the attitude of a champion.”

name: Smilodon
description:
Smilodon, commonly known as the saber-toothed cat, was a remarkable and iconic predator that lived during the Pleistocene epoch. These large cats were characterized by their long, curved canine teeth, which were adapted for stabbing and slashing rather than simply biting.

There are several species of Smilodon, with Smilodon fatalis being one of the most well-known. These saber-toothed cats were formidable predators, likely preying on large herbivores such as bison and camels. The length of their canines indicates a specialized hunting strategy, using their impressive teeth to deliver powerful and precise bites to the necks of their prey.

name: Daeodon
description:
Daeodon, also known as Dinohyus, was a large, prehistoric pig-like mammal that lived in North America during the Oligocene and Miocene epochs. This creature was a member of the entelodont family, a group of omnivorous pig-like mammals with distinctive features.

Daeodon was characterized by its robust build, long legs, and a large head with powerful jaws. It had sharp teeth and was likely an opportunistic omnivore, feeding on both plant material and scavenging for meat. Despite its pig-like appearance, Daeodon was not a direct ancestor of modern pigs.

name: Enemies>Halo 3>The Flood>Pure Tank
description:
When a stalker form is cornered or confronted with well-armed opponents, it will often undergo a rapid transformation into a tank form to better defend itself. Most of the stalker's body mass shifts to the frontal body section, forming a muscular torso. The rear limbs are augmented with muscle to serve as legs, while the forelimbs become bulkier and rapidly extrude bone structures to form blade or club-like appendages. In this state, the tank form is more resistant to conventional weaponry and possesses more devastating melee capabilities, but moves at a far slower pace.

Tank forms are quite slow in comparison to combat forms, but they make up for it with relative resilience and devastating melee attacks. Sudirman (Old Spelling: Soedirman; 24 January 1916 – 29 January 1950) was a high-ranking Indonesian military officer during the Indonesian National Revolution. The first commander of the Indonesian National Armed Forces, he continues to be widely respected in the country.

The statue of General Sudirman is one of the statues located in Jakarta precisely in the Upper Dukuh area, front of the BNI Building, Jalan Jenderal Sudirman. This statue is made of bronze weighing 4 tons with a budget of 3.5 billion Rupiah and done by artists as well as lecturers of art Institut Teknologi Bandung, SunaryoThe figure of General Sudirman is described as standing firmly respectfully and the head slightly looked up to give a dynamic impression. Because it stands in the middle of an area full of activities, the sculpture is deliberately designed simple and does not require much detail.

name: Roman Shop threshold, Ostia
description:
This threshold was once the entrance to a store in Ostia. The large entrance gives people outside a good view of the interior, of the goods and the decorations, drawing them in so that they will hopefully spend money. The threshold creates a clear distinction between the outside and the shopping space, putting shoppers in a mindset to shop as soon as they step in. This threshold in particular opens onto a mosaic. Not only were mosaics decorative and beautiful they were also signifiers of wealth thus they made the shop desirable for not only its appearance but also for it's success.The threshold not only creates a clear seperation with the shop and the outside world, it also has a groove where shop owners would put boards to lock up at the end of the night.



Created in Metashape for the Virtual Roman Retail project with the permission of the Parco
Archeologico di Ostia Antica.

Original=86.82MB Decimated=72.22MB

https://www.ostia-antica.org/regio5/5/5-1.htm

name: Vintage Wooden Desk – Ornamental | Game Ready
description:
This is a realistic vintage wooden desk created for game environments and real-time rendering.

The focus of this project was to capture the aged wooden surface, subtle wear, and ornamental detailing while maintaining a clean and optimized mesh suitable for real-time applications. Special attention was given to material breakup, edge wear, and surface imperfections to achieve a believable, slightly worn look.

The model includes decorative panel detailing and metallic drawer handles, adding character and storytelling to the asset.

Key Features:
• Game-ready optimized geometry
• Clean topology and efficient UV layout
• High-quality PBR textures (Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Normal, AO)
• Detailed wood grain with realistic wear and aging
• Decorative ornamental panel for added visual interest
• Suitable for Unity, Unreal Engine, and real-time rendering

This asset is ideal for interior environments, vintage scenes, and cinematic setups.

Created using Blender, RizomUV and Substance Painter.

name: Basin Campfire Center - Post Fire (2026)
description: A photogrammetric model of the campfire center/former outdoor amphitheater located in the heart of the old growth redwood grove in Big Basin Redwoods State Park as it appears in June 2026. name: quantum_wave_Ψ(x,t)
description:
This quantum wave shape implements the Schrödinger Wave Function Ψ(x,t) with probability density visualization:

**Core Mathematical Formula:**
* Free particle wave function: Ψ(x,t) = A exp[i(kx - ωt)]
* With Gaussian wave packet envelope for uncertainty principle
Ψ(x,t) = A × exp(-x²/(2σ²)) × exp[i(kx - ωt)]

**Where:**
- A = amplitude (parameter b)
- σ = uncertainty width (parameter e) 
- k = wave number = n×π/L (parameter c = quantum number)
- ω = angular frequency (parameter d)
- x = spatial coordinate
- t = time (implicit in animation)

Feel free to use for education and learning, non-commercial, contact for additional licensing.

name: Castillo - Torreparedones | SPAIN
description:
Existe constancia de la presencia musulmana en Torreparedones entre el Califato de Córdoba (siglo X) hasta al menos el siglo XII tal y como demuestra la cerámica y numismática hallada, así como algunas estructuras murarias. Tras la conquista cristiana a mediados del siglo XIII, comenzó a conocerse con el nombre de «Castro el Viejo» y se alzaba muy cercano a la frontera entre la Corona de Castilla y el Reino nazarí de Granada. Por este motivo, a finales del siglo XIII se construyó el castillo de Torreparedones, en forma trapezoidal, apareciendo en esta fecha las primeras referencias. Perteneció al monarca Alfonso X hasta que lo cedió a Fernán Alonso de Lastres, comendador de la Orden de Santiago y alcaide del castillo de Baena, por los esfuerzos militares de la Reconquista, manteniendo su papel estratégico.

name: Koktobe TV Tower (Almaty)
description:
The Almaty Television Tower, formally the Koktobe TV Tower (Kazakh: «Көктөбе» телемұнарасы; Russian: Телебашня «Коктобе») is a 371.5-metre-high (1,219 ft) steel television tower built between 1975 and 1983 in Almaty, Kazakhstan. The tower is located on high slopes of Kok Tobe mountain (Kazakh: Көктөбе means "green hill") south-east of downtown Almaty. Unlike other similar TV towers, it is not a concrete, but a steel tubular structure. It is the tallest free-standing tubular steel structure in the world.

The model preserves recognizable shapes, proportions and important details while remaining suitable for real-time scenes and general 3D production. name: DANCING BOY OF HARAPPA — 1000 YRS BEFORE GREECE
description:
A Bronze Age sculptor in Indo-Pakistan, 4,500 years ago, carved the human body with a mastery Greece would not achieve for another 1,000 years. Full contrapposto pose. Observed musculature. Possibly modelled from a living individual — the earliest portrait in South Asian history.

Only the 9.9cm torso survives. For over 100 years nobody knew what the complete figure looked like.

This is the world's first complete reconstruction — built using AI (Meshy.ai + Tripo3D) from the geometry of the surviving limb stumps. Juvenile male, dynamic dancing pose, left leg raised, torso twisted. Possibly the earliest prototype of Shiva Nataraja.

The greatest sculpture of any Bronze Age civilisation. Finally complete.

Full paper    : https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20556231
Academia.edu: https://www.academia.edu/168247356
Author              : Naeem Ahmed Rasheed
Independent Researcher, Indus Valley Civilisation Studies, Lahore, Pakistan

name: Old Pirate Coin
description:
The coin was heavy, far too heavy for its size. Its surface was tarnished silver, etched with curling patterns that seemed to writhe when held to the firelight. At the center, a skull grinned with teeth sharpened by centuries of fear, and across its surface dark dried blood that no storm could wash away.

They called it the Kraken’s Fare, Legends said each coin was hammered from the melted chains of men dragged below by the deep sea. Sailors whispered that if you pressed your ear against it, you would hear the screams of the drowned.

The patterns circling the skull were not decoration. They told a story—spirals that spoke of storms, knots that bound curses, waves that crashed endlessly against the ship.

But the bloodstains were fresh. Every owner of the coin paid a price, for the Fare demanded passage. When the sea grew still and the gulls fell silent, the one who carried it would feel cold hands tugging at their throat.

It was never truly a coin of wealth...paid not in silver, but in souls.

name: Barrel_ Hammer
description:
Stylized Barrel Hammer — учебный 3D-prop, созданный как стартовая работа для моего портфолио.

Модель выполнена по туториалу, но основной целью для меня было не просто повторить результат, а пройти и закрепить ключевые этапы создания игрового объекта:

* поиск и сборка чистого силуэта
* 
* работа с крупными и вторичными формами
* 
* создание стилизованных материалов
* 
* настройка презентации модели для real-time showcase

Мне хотелось передать немного cartoon / fantasy настроения через преувеличенные формы, мягкие пропорции и контраст материалов: дерево, окрашенный металл, верёвка и декоративные элементы.

Это моя одна из первых работ, с которой я начинаю собирать своё 3D-портфолио, поэтому особенно открыт к конструктивному фидбеку.

Tools: Blender / Substance Painter / Marmoset Toolbag 5

name: Virtual Room - Roman faces and heads
description:

Hemos aprovechado la ocasión para preparar una colección de 8 piezas optimizadas en 3D susceptibles de ser visualizadas y/o manipuladas en todo tipo de dispositivos.
La escultura romana ha plasmado magistralmente los detalles. Y con esos rostros, que son el reflejo del alma, intentaron transmitir algo más. Hemos seleccionado estas piezas, elaboradas con diferentes fines y temáticas, que nos cuentan cosas de las gentes que las mandaron erigir y de su entorno.

description:
THIS MODEL HAS A VERY SPECIFIC RIGGING AND SHADERS, AND WILL ONLY WORK PROPERLY IN BLENDER)
  
RENDERS AND ANIMATIONS HERE: https://youtu.be/mUR5lCtS__g
TIMELAPSE AND BEHIND THE SCENES HERE: https://www.patreon.com/posts/eldritch-ralsei-92036326

This was an interesting little experiment.

I've been wanting to play some with bendy bones, which are segmented bones that are able to bend and curve, but I didn't know WHAT to test that with...but then i had an idea. So I took the Eldritch Ralsei that I drew for my art accounts a while back, and decided to make him a 3d model!

Took me about 4 hours and 10 minutes, from modelling, shading, rigging and rendering, done everything in Blender. Keep in mind that, while you can download the blend file, I did this as an experiment, so it's not unwrapped, nor is it properly weight painted AT ALL. It was merely a test for bendy bones that I did to play around!

In the early 1980s, the F-111F began to be equipped with the AVQ-26 Pave Tack forward looking infrared (FLIR) and laser designator system, which enabled the use of precision laser-guided munitions and was mounted in the internal weapons bay. The Pacer Strike avionics update program replaced analog equipment with new digital equipment and multi-function displays. name: Clackmannan Tower
description:
Clackmannan Tower is the imposing keep of a 1300s tower house, visited by Robert Burns and built by a descendant of Robert the Bruce, standing on King’s Seat Hill, a site rich with royal connections.

The surviving building, comprising two adjoining towers, is a complicated structure. The earliest part - the lower half of the north tower - was probably built by Sir Robert Bruce of Clackmannan around 1360. 

At some time in the 15th century, that building was comprehensively remodelled: doubled in height and a south tower (or jamb) added, thus creating an L-plan. 
 Clackmannan Tower was abandoned as a residence by 1800, and the mansion alone demolished by 1841. 
 
 The tower itself has suffered considerably from structural damage caused by underground coal-workings.

To learn more about visiting Clackmannan Tower, go to [our website.](https://www.historicenvironment.scot/visit-a-place/places/clackmannan-tower/)

Rae Project | [PIC018](https://canmore.org.uk/site/48302/clackmannan-tower)

name: Volkswagen Type 2 1970 (Game-Ready Vehicle)
description:
This Volkswagen is a complete rebuild of one of my earliest 3D projects, originally created while following a Udemy course. While the course was a great starting point, the original model lacked proper shading, efficient UV unwrapping, and production-ready topology.
Now, with over three years of experience in 3D modeling, I’ve revisited the project to bring it up to a professional standard. The model was rebuilt from scratch with a focus on clean geometry, optimized UV layout, consistent texel density, and accurate physically based shading.
The final asset consists of ~145K triangles, distributed across 6 UV sets, most of which use 4K textures to ensure high visual fidelity.
You can check 4K renders on my [ArtStation](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/V2v5k5).

Mechagodzilla is my favorite Godzilla monster of all time and I wanted to do something for him for his 50th anniversary. Big thanks to ViolisModels for helping me out with his textures.

name: MASSACRADE - The Sniper
description:
Long range-tier enemy for **MASSACRADE**.

He represents a rare tier of enemy which requires a countermeasure to proceed against. Out of all current Enemy types he is the most valuable one, resulting in his design. Being able to wield a gun in our game is a rarity, which is the main reason for his value. The Eyes glow so that they are better visible in our environment.

Artstyle wise we went for a mixture between *Dishonoured 2, Arcane, Bioshock*. The Textures are hand painted albedo with baked normals from the high poly, also some stylization on top of the roughness for more interesting light bounces.

All 4 Enemies were done simultaneously for time-efficiency. Took me 1.5 months for all 4 enemies together, from nothing to end result. 

*For Sketchfab I used Texture Maps that can be used here, in Engine the Texture maps are packed like ORM Map instead of 3 individual ones, The bone placement here is kinda broken, in Engine it is different.*

description:
"O Coelhão" nasceu para ser o Boss do evento de Páscoa no projeto do jogo Priston Zero, um novo MMORPG criado por André Bales da Crazy Pixel. Como fui responsável por transformar o personagem em um ativo 3D funcional.

Ver o bicho ganhando vida e funcionando dentro do jogo dá uma satisfação fantástica que valeu cada hora de dedicação!

-

Workflow : Modélisation assistée par IA (génération de base + retouches sculptées).

A crusty old-school 3D artist with a library of custom brushes and a chip on his shoulder, he’s declared full-scale war on AI-generated images and meshes. “It’s digital plagiarism with a user interface,” he barks in Discord servers, disgusted by the flood of AI content getting likes from people who can’t tell topology from texture maps. To Elliot, art without intent is just noise. He’s watched his industry — once fueled by obsessive craftsmanship — become overrun with instant, soulless junk pumped out by bots and keyboard jockeys. “It’s not art if you didn’t suffer for it,” he insists, clutching his worn-out Wacom pen like a weapon. name: Nellie P. Downey
description:
The wooden two-masted schooner Nellie P. Downey (84x20x7.3') was built in 1873 by Robert Robinson at Napanee, Ontario. On the evening of Thursday, June 12, 1884, Nellie P. Downey was approaching Oswego, laden with 6,700 bushels of rye from Napanee. That evening a thick fog covered the lake, limiting visibility. Around 8:00 p.m., Captain Robert Bartley of Nellie P. Downey sighted the lights of the tugboat Glide passing by. Bartley believed the tug to be one of the Oswego harbor tugboats coming out to tow them in, not seeing its barges in tow. As Downey passed astern of Glide to take up the towing line, it was struck amidships by the barge Oswego and foundered in less than 5 minutes, without loss of life.

Nellie P. Downey was first discovered by Mr. Daniel Scoville and Mr. Chris Koberstein in July 2013 off Oswego, New York. In May 2025, NOAA and its partners at the Ocean Exploration Cooperative Institute documented the site using a remotely operated vehicle, identifying the wreck as Nellie P. Downey.

name: Threaded Cylindrical Mechanical/Plumbing Fitting
description: A structured-light scan–derived mesh model of a heavily corroded ferrous cylindrical fitting, possibly a threaded plug, cap, coupling, or related mechanical/plumbing component. One end appears to retain a faceted or hexagonal wrenching surface. Recovered out of context from mixed backfill in the area of the original lighthouse location at present-day Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The deposit reflects multiple episodes of activity and disturbance, so it cannot be confidently associated with the c. 1847-48 original lighthouse occupation at this location. Best interpreted as historic-period machine-made hardware, probably  late 19th to early 20th century. 3D mesh created through structured light scanning. The project is in collaboration with Thomas Penders (CRM Space Launch Delta 45, CCSFS).  3D model and associated digital collection produced by Argonne National Laboratory. Field Specimen: FS# 8BR234.05_62_03.002.2.

name: Dated Inscription
description:
This inscription was first discovered in 2019 in Pulihan Hamlet, Tajuk Village, Getasan District, Semarang Regency. It was found by Warin Darsono, a man from Salatiga, while visiting his grandmother's house.
The current condition of the carvings—as shown when this 3D data was captured—differs significantly from when it was first discovered. The numbers “5” and “3” are no longer clearly visible, leaving only faint outlines that make it difficult to recognize the original details.
The creation of this 3D model will, at the very least, assist future researchers in analyzing and comparing the remaining carvings.

name: Nigeria – Aso Oke - wedding dress
description:
**Aso Oke: Nigeria’s Regal Thread of Matrimony**

In Nigerian Yoruba culture, the Aso Oke wedding dress is more than attire—it is a symbol of heritage, pride, and celebration. Woven by hand from thick, luxurious fabric, Aso Oke (meaning “top cloth”) is traditionally worn by brides to honor ancestral craftsmanship and cultural identity.

The ensemble often includes the iro (wrapper), buba (blouse), and gele (head tie), each richly adorned with metallic threads, intricate patterns, and vibrant colors like royal blue, wine red, or gold. These hues reflect joy, prosperity, and the sacred bond of marriage.

Aso Oke is not merely decorative—it carries the weight of tradition, passed down through generations. Brides donning this regal fabric embody grace, strength, and the enduring beauty of Yoruba customs. In every fold and shimmer, the Aso Oke tells a story of love rooted in legacy.

name: Gullmávurinn - Bátur Kjarvals
description: Þegar Kjarval varð sjötugur var honum gefinn norskur trébátur. Draumur Kjarvals varð að sigla bátnum niður Selfljót og yfir á Borgarfjörð. Kjarval lét drauminn rætast þremur árum eftir að hann eignaðist bátinn og sigldi þá frá ystu brúnni yfir Selfljót og yfir á Borgarfjörð. Kjarval hafi heimtað að sigla bátnum hjálparlaust en bílstjóri hans fylgdist með honum úr landi og síðar líka Andrés Björnsson, bóndi á Snotrunesi í Borgarfirði. Kjarval lenti í vandræðum á grynningum á leiðinni út en eftir að komst yfir þeir var leiðin greið. Þetta var fyrsta og eina ferð Gullmávsins og aldrei ljóstraði Kjarval upp hver hugmyndin hefði nákvæmlega verið á bakvið siglinguna. Báturinn hefur síðan lengst af verið geymdur í bátaskýli í Kjarvalshvammi.

name: Draped Female Statue
description:
Although the head, arms, lower legs, and feet are missing, the surviving body still gives a strong impression of elegance and dignity. The fabric clings and falls across the figure in carefully arranged folds, revealing the form beneath while also covering it with a sense of restraint and decorum. The sculpture was probably carved around the 2nd–1st century BCE, during the Hellenistic period, and was discovered on the island of Delos in the Aegean. Without the head or any clear attribute, the figure cannot be identified with certainty. She may have represented a goddess, an idealized female devotee, or an affluent woman connected with a sanctuary or wealthy household. Today, the statue is displayed in the Archaeological Museum of Delos, Greece.

View Artifact: https://thevimu.com/draped-female-statue-c-0-200-bce/

name: 「桐紋の瓦」（鹿児島城跡）
description:
鹿児島城跡（鹿児島市）の発掘調査では，多くの瓦が見つかっています。軒丸瓦，軒平瓦，丸瓦，平瓦，鬼瓦等々。今回はその中から，「桐紋の瓦」（軒丸瓦）を紹介します。

「桐紋」は，桐の花や葉を模した家紋の一種で，特に豊臣秀吉の家紋として知られています。

見つかった「桐紋の瓦」は四七桐紋（中心に花が７つ，左右に４つ）で，17世紀前半に作られたものです。一般的な「太閤紋」の五七桐紋（中心に花が７つ，左右に５つ）とはやや異なりますが，当時の政治的関係を推測することができます。
